_comment: Gain / operating-point / threshold profile for verify_cosim_pid.py. RAW gains include the sign (integer P NEGATIVE, float P POSITIVE). MODEL+BUILD specific (GroupTb WAFER, VARIATION_SEED=0, sinusoid-blend build). The seed is phase-scaled to the 23 uA SQ1 period; gains and thresholds are retained from the old 10 uA fixture and require closed-loop revalidation. These are NOT physical SQUID acceptance. Copy and adjust per fixture. Any block/key is optional; omitted values fall back to the built-in DEFAULTS in verify_cosim_pid.py, and --cli flags override this file.
